name: EVA
author: hundekraft
description: A warm, sung pad with the sound of early-80s film scores. Two slightly detuned oscillators, a saw and a soft pulse, go through a lowpass with a gentle vowel colour on top, then through a wide ensemble chorus. Each voice has a slow vibrato and drifts a little on its own, so held chords slowly shift. The helmet radio sits on Com: low settings just warm the sound up, high settings bring in hiss, dropouts and the radio's beeps.
